title: 22 New Blocks for Existing Categories
summary: 22 new blocks fill gaps in six existing block pages: OTP, Reset Password, Tiptap editor, API keys, Career and FAQ, with search keywords so the MCP server finds them.
body:
Six existing block pages now cover more of what real products need. Every block keeps its own state, validates its own input and takes typed props with fictional sample data.

#### Verification and passwords (6)

- 3 more OTP verification blocks under **Forgot and Reset Password**
- 3 more reset password blocks: a second full page form, an expired link screen and a change password form

#### Tiptap editor (4)

- A minimal editor, a bubble menu editor, a comment or notes editor and a blog post editor

#### API keys (4)

- A create key dialog, a scopes picker, a usage table and a webhooks manager, added to **Settings - Workspace**

#### Career (4)

- A filterable job board, a job detail page, an application form with resume upload and a hiring process with perks

#### FAQ (4)

- A search with highlighted matches, an accordion with helpful votes, a grouped FAQ with a support card and an ask a question form with suggestions

#### MCP

- Search keywords added for Career, FAQ and Tiptap, and extended for OTP, Reset Password and API keys
- Block docs links already resolve to the existing pages, so no new routes were needed
